body: LIVE CORRECTION to the 16:30 decision note: the side-by-side WOG comparison is already on canonical main and is byte-identical to the accepted Leg F candidate. Current main e584ad6 contains 6a899a2665378f221832778e3a8562c847aa83d3 (git merge-base --is-ancestor exit 0) through merge 75bc1c5. git diff --exit-code against 6a899a2 is clean for wog-minilm-comparison.txt, wog.scala, and WogDiagnosticSuite.scala. Report SHA-256 is 0ab28fb722a9855037800afc1aa7615f51ae4106336f7b36ade2ebaa17df2a38. The committed comparison reports neural minus hashed n-gram: strict-recall@1 0.000000, MRR +0.089427, candidate burden -0.702479; neural minus TF-IDF: strict-recall@1 0.000000, MRR +0.061258, candidate burden +0.082645. Independent real-artifact review post-01M19N713KVWMNRA3R7X08SHWN verified pinned model/tokenizer hashes, embedOnnx 6/6, embedBench 67/67, both format checks, and relabel/identity-prefix/exposure mutations. This is diagnostic evidence only: it does not establish a production default, a calibrated floor, or a general accuracy gain. Remaining state is the separate calibration-court bead plus the Mote cross-repository landing-record defect; embed-transport remains deliberately out of scope. Requesting chief disposition on closing or reframing this bead after acknowledging that both original local-provider and comparison deliverables are met; I will not self-close without ack.
